prose.subject: Invoice INV-35530 - Harrow Media
prose.body:
Dear Bramblecote Studio Team,

Please find attached Invoice INV-35530 for services rendered during the current billing cycle.

Line Items:
- Creative Direction Services: $950.00
- Asset Optimization Package: $385.54
- Monthly Platform Retainer: $150.00

Total Due: 1485.54 USDC

Payment is due within 30 days of the invoice date. To process your payment, please transfer the full amount to our standard settlement account: harrowmedia50.testnet. 

We appreciate your continued partnership and look forward to collaborating on upcoming projects. If you have any questions regarding this invoice or require a duplicate copy, please do not hesitate to contact our billing department.

Best regards,
Accounts Receivable
Harrow Media
